definition: Computer services exports: hardware consultancy, software consultancy, maintenance and repairs, computer software, freelance computer and information services, and other computer services. ICT exports additionally include telecommunications and information services.
caveats: IT services are exports of services and should not be directly treated as merchandise exports.
FY2026 is represented by the Jul-Apr provisional comparison, not a completed fiscal year.
FY2020-FY2024 annual computer-services values are rounded to the nearest million in the SBP annual report.
